forms.code:
def popsum_bits(n: int) -> int:
    total = 0
    bit = 1
    while bit <= n:
        period = bit * 2
        total += (n + 1) // period * bit
        rest = (n + 1) % period - bit
        if rest > 0:
            total += rest
        bit = period
    return total
